answer: Randomized Slot Assignment. Each round, a public beacon assigns agents to verification slots drawn from a fixed trellis of shards, and an agent's reward depends on slot occupancy patterns it cannot predict. Because the assignment is post-commitment, a Sybil cannot concentrate identities where returns are highest. To game occupancy, an attacker must flood every shard per round, paying full compute and terrace bandwidth for each identity on every draw. Identities failing randomized audits lose their copper payout and are evicted,
